periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, approximately 45-60 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, sloping upwards and outwards toward the pinnae.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertically elongated oval, with height approximately double the width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering, resulting in a teardrop-like extension of the patch below the geometric center.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High relative thickness observed at the lateral flanks where the band merges with the thoracic limb pigmentation.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Moderate separation, with the inter-ear gap roughly equivalent to the horizontal width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Semicircular and smooth convex curvature at the superior margins with no visible flattening.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant brownish-yellow chromogenic staining of the fur throughout the ventral and abdominal regions.
